name: What kind of return on investment (ROI) can I expect from a fourplex?

mainEntity.name: What kind of return on investment (ROI) can I expect from a fourplex?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ROI on a fourplex varies significantly based on purchase price, rental income, operating expenses, and market conditions. Generally, investors look for a positive cash flow after all expenses, including mortgage, taxes, insurance, and maintenance. Calculating a realistic ROI requires a thorough analysis of comparable rental properties in specific markets like Collier or Orange County and understanding local vacancy rates.
acceptedAnswer.description: ROI for a fourplex depends on purchase price, rental income, and expenses, varying by market. Analyze local comparables for a realistic estimate.
